registry: VCG Feature Scanner classical ECG baseline source lock

sources.title: Electrocardiographic Diagnosis of Acute Coronary Occlusion MI in Ventricular Paced Rhythm Using Modified Sgarbossa Criteria
sources.implementation_scope: Standard modified components in confirmed ventricular paced morphology; no V4-V6 extension or locally validated probability

sources.title: Diagnosis of STEMI in LBBB with the ST-elevation to S-wave ratio in a modified Sgarbossa rule
sources.implementation_scope: LBBB morphology components; no independent validation claim for ventricular pacing

sources.title: Fourth Universal Definition of Myocardial Infarction (2018)
sources.implementation_scope: Q-wave component only; not a complete prior-MI diagnosis. QS, posterior R equivalents and clinical confounders require separate assessment.

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS Recommendations for the Standardization and Interpretation of the Electrocardiogram, Part I
sources.implementation_scope: ECG acquisition, technology and general interpretation provenance

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS ECG Standardization, Part IV: ST Segment, T and U Waves, and QT Interval
AHA/ACCF/HRS ECG Standardization, Part V: Cardiac Chamber Hypertrophy
sources.implementation_scope: LVH, RVH and atrial enlargement ECG comparators

sources.title: AHA/ACCF/HRS ECG Standardization, Part VI: Acute Ischemia/Infarction
sources.implementation_scope: ST, T-wave, Q-wave and infarction-pattern comparators

sources.title: 2025 ACC/AHA/ACEP/NAEMSP/SCAI Guideline for Acute Coronary Syndromes
sources.implementation_scope: Clinical ACS context; not used as an ECG-label gold standard

sources.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation
sources.implementation_scope: AF follow-up context and explicit absence of a stand-alone future-AF ECG baseline

sources.title: Recommendations for Cardiac Chamber Quantification by Echocardiography in Adults
sources.implementation_scope: Clinical echo reference thresholds; not an ECG comparator

sources.title: Guidelines for the Echocardiographic Assessment of the Right Heart in Adults and Special Considerations in Pulmonary Hypertension
sources.implementation_scope: Current right-heart size, function and hemodynamic reference context. Protocol-specified label thresholds remain versioned and are never silently retuned after development starts.

sources.title: Characteristic electrocardiographic pattern indicating a critical stenosis high in left anterior descending coronary artery in patients admitted because of impending myocardial infarction
sources.implementation_scope: Named Wellens morphology comparator; clinical context is not inferred from ECG morphology

sources.title: A New ECG Sign of Proximal LAD Occlusion
sources.implementation_scope: Named de Winter morphology comparator; occlusion is not inferred without clinical reference evidence

sources.title: Electrocardiographic manifestations of pulmonary embolism
sources.implementation_scope: S1Q3T3 as a nonspecific supportive right-heart-strain pattern

sources.title: Prevalence and prognostic value of electrocardiographic abnormalities in hypokalemia: A multicenter cohort study
sources.implementation_scope: Supports explicit absence of a sufficiently sensitive stand-alone binary ECG diagnostic rule for hypokalemia; laboratory potassium remains the reference

notes: This local metadata lock pins the exact sources and implementation scope used by the registry. It contains bibliographic metadata, not copyrighted source documents. Any edit changes the SHA-256 included in run provenance.
